messages:
sam: noticed p50 jumps for embedding queries from eu3 since 01:10 UTC. flamegraphs point at huge socket wait on host-gpu-21f.
jiho: I see NIC tx queue spikes and `tx_retransmit` on tor-eu3-02 for that rack.
marta: quick question: are these customers on shared nodes or dedicated?
sam: mixed; mostly shared warmpool + a few ad-hoc customer batches.
jiho: plan: immediate mitigation = limit warmpool egress on hosts with congestion via tc and mark nodes so scheduler avoids them for latency-sensitive pods. I'll push labels.
infra-bot: labeler applied `egress_throttle=true` on hosts [host-gpu-21f, host-gpu-21g]. ticket INFRA-913 created.
marta: can we use SR-IOV VF carveouts for dedicated slices long-term? that would prevent host-level egress contention.
jiho: SR-IOV is promising but needs NIC firmware + host driver validation; schedule probe. short-term TC is lower risk.
sam: please estimate cost if we migrate warmpool off these hosts vs throttling. data-move ~800GB per host if we pack elsewhere.
jiho: throttling cost ~0 (longer warmup), migration cost ~$40-120 per host in cross-az egress. recommend tc + label for 30m.
ops-bot: applied tc `tbf rate 400mbit burst 64k latency 100ms` to warmpool pods on affected hosts.
(6 minutes)
jiho: telemetry: p50 back down from 310ms -> 70ms. retransmits reduced.
marta: ok. follow-ups: 1) infra: run SR-IOV feasibility test (INFRA-914) 2) scheduler: add `egress_throttle` to avoidance window for 1h (OPS-4550) 3) ops: open HW ticket for NIC errors.
sam: add cost metrics to INFRA-913 so we can quantify migration vs throttling tradeoff.
jiho: closing for now, will monitor 1h and then clear labels if stable.
